info.name: Insilico simulation API
info.description:
Hand-runnable companion to the pytest suite in ../tests.

This collection is deliberately small. It exists because a scientist or a product manager needs to be able to poke the endpoint without a Python environment, and because Task 3 asks for a Postman artefact. It is not the automated safety net — the pytest suite is, and it covers the same ground plus property-based and metamorphic checks that a collection cannot express.

Expected values are hand-computed and written into the assertions as literal constants, with the arithmetic shown in a comment. An assertion that recomputes the formula it is checking will agree with a broken implementation whenever the formula itself is the bug.

Run headless:
  newman run simulation.postman_collection.json --env-var baseUrl=http://127.0.0.1:8000
